name: Rhys Williams
bio:
Rhys developed a passion for motorsport early on, growing up near a local speedway. He started his career in automotive refinishing, honing his skills on classic cars before transitioning to motorsport through a contact at a local racing team. His meticulous approach and eye for detail quickly made him an asset.

Joining ART Grand Prix Academy was a significant step up for Rhys. He takes immense pride in ensuring every car leaves the paint shop looking flawless, knowing even the smallest imperfections can affect aerodynamics and team morale. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to troubleshoot complex painting issues with minimal fuss. Rhys prefers working independently, focusing intently on the task at hand.

physical.description: Rhys is of average height and build, with a focused expression.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when the paint shop is quiet.
Has a collection of vintage car magazines he reads during breaks.
Insists on using only a specific brand of masking tape.
